body:
Hi Wayne,

Thirty nine years of painting in Houston, fully insured, near perfect ratings on Angi and HomeAdvisor, and a homeowner searching for a painter tonight will never see your name. Not because of your work. Because Superior Paint Works has no website, and search results belong to whoever shows up online. The companies getting those calls are not better painters. They are just visible.

A website puts your record where people actually look. Your services in plain words, your ratings up front where they calm a nervous homeowner down, your phone number one tap away, and a simple quote request that lands in your inbox. For a company with your history, the site does not need to sell hard. It just needs to exist and look like the business you have run since 1986.

Painting sites are familiar work for me. Elkhorn Painting has a clean site built to turn searches into quote requests. I also built the home service sites like Total Plumbing, simple and fast, made for phones because that is where the searching happens.

I will mock up your homepage first, free, with your real services and ratings on it, so you can judge the work before spending anything. Like it, we launch it on your own domain.

Worth a look?

Thanks for your time,
Hassan
name: Superior Paint Works Inc
subject: 🎨 Wayne, painting Houston since 1986 and Google cannot find you

body:
Hi Ariel,

You are on the Wells Branch recommended vendor list, which says a lot, because neighbors only recommend a plumber who showed up, fixed it properly and charged fairly. That kind of trust is the hardest thing in this trade to earn. Here is the catch: it only exists inside that neighborhood list. A homeowner two suburbs over with water on the floor searches Google, and Ariel's Plumbing simply is not there. No website, no listing, nothing to call.

A basic website would carry your reputation further than word of mouth can walk. Your services, your area, your number big and clear, and the recommendation you already earned sitting right on the page. Plumbers with half your neighborhood trust get found because they have that one page. You should too.

Plumbing sites are a big part of my work. Total Plumbing has a clean, fast site built around getting the call. Big Birge Plumbing is a family plumbing company presented the same way, simple and trustworthy.

I will mock up your homepage first, free, no pressure attached. If you like what Austin would see, we put it on your own domain.

Worth a look?

Best,
